orders.sentence: Limit each signed-in user to ten requests per 60 seconds on the link API, counting failed requests too, and answer over-limit requests with 429.

Write one audit event for every request under /api/, recording the method, the path, the signed-in user or anonymous, and the final status, and never the password, the authorization header or the session cookie.
Let a link owner set an expiry time when creating a link, and answer requests for an expired link with 404.
Let a user choose a custom short code when creating a link, using 3 to 32 letters, digits or underscores, and answer 409 when the code is already in use.
Paginate GET /api/links with a limit of up to 100 and an opaque cursor, and return the next cursor whenever more links exist.
Let a user delete their own account, which revokes every session they hold and deletes the links they own.
Show each link's clicks in the last 24 hours on the dashboard, next to its total clicks.
Send a Retry-After header on every 429 response, in whole seconds rounded up.
Stop writing audit events for anonymous requests, and keep writing them for signed-in requests.
Add POST /api/logout-all, which revokes every session of the signed-in user and returns how many were revoked.
Require passwords of at least 12 characters at signup and answer 400 to shorter ones.
Change the link API rate limit window from 60 seconds to 120 seconds.
